name: Porting Strategies for Gravitational N-Body Simulations on Tenstorrent Wormhole
description: Evaluates three strategies for scaling an N-body code across multiple Tenstorrent Wormhole accelerators. Builds on the established performance of single-card N-body work to explore parallelism via the on-chip NoC and multi-accelerator configurations.
author: Jenny Lynn Almerol, Elisabetta Boella, Mario Spera, Daniele Gregori
